reason: Proxy rows expose request_id but no child/session/tool-call identity; this reviewed format has no independently validated bridge to child lifecycle IDs. Agent metrics are aggregate snapshots, not proxy request receipts. Runtime configured models are not immutable workflow declarations.

nativeCodeGrounding.finding: Structured child lifecycle keys exist; final retry/source scope matters. Request usage objects do not independently establish a proxy-to-child identity bridge.

The inspected per-request proxy credit matcher is Pi-only and uses first matching model/token quartet in observed order. It is not unique native child-dispatch identity proof and is not ported as such.

decision: Do not implement an accepting proxy-to-child decoder from these formats. Keep the operational collector fail-closed and all retained outcomes unknown.
scope: The two fixture requests are resolved. No three-run metadata, history acquisition or further network access was authorized or performed.
